# SmartAnalyst

> SmartAnalyst is an AI-powered marketing analyst that turns raw data from GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Stripe and Search Console into clear answers — with causes, evidence and recommended actions.

Ask any question about your marketing performance ("Why did conversions drop yesterday?", "Which campaign drove revenue last week?") and get a structured, source-cited answer in seconds. No more switching between five dashboards to build a story by hand.

## What it does

- **Cross-source intelligence**: connects GA4, Meta Ads, Facebook + Instagram, Google Ads, Stripe, Google Search Console (roadmap: Shopify, HubSpot, Mailchimp, LinkedIn Ads)
- **Canonical metrics layer**: normalizes "sessions" (GA4) / "reach" (Meta) / "impressions" (Google Ads) / "successful_payments" (Stripe) into one consistent vocabulary so the AI never confuses apples and oranges
- **Conversational analyst**: ask in plain French or English; answers come with the underlying metric values, time range and contributing factors
- **Proactive insights**: weekly Monday email surfacing anomalies, opportunities and risks across all connected sources
- **Reports**: auto-generated monthly PDFs with executive summary, ready to send to stakeholders or clients
- **White-label**: agencies on Pro/Agency plans can rebrand the dashboard and reports with their logo and colors

## Who it's for

- **Marketing freelancers** piloting their own performance
- **Agencies** managing 5–20+ client portfolios (white-label, multi-workspace)
- **Startup / SMB founders** preparing monthly investor updates without a data team

## Pricing

- **Découverte (Free)** — 1 workspace, 1 connector, 3 proactive insights / month. No card required. 14-day full-feature trial.
- **Starter — 99 €/month HT** — 5 workspaces, 3 connectors, 100 insights, auto-send reports, logo white-label.
- **Pro — 199 €/month HT** — 20 workspaces, all P1 connectors, 500 insights, logo + colors white-label. ★ recommended for agencies.
- **Agency — 399 €/month HT** — unlimited workspaces, all connectors, unlimited insights, full white-label.

Every plan includes a monthly AI credit allowance scaled to the plan's audience (Discovery for evaluation, Starter for solo use, Pro/Agency for intensive multi-client). Real-time balance + 80% alert, no surprise overage. Cancel anytime, EU hosting (Supabase Ireland), invoices in euros incl. VAT.

## Architecture & security

- Frontend: Astro (marketing) + React/Vite (SaaS app at app.smartanalyst.io)
- Backend: Node + Express, Postgres via Supabase, BullMQ workers, Redis
- AI: Anthropic Claude (Haiku for fast, Sonnet for deep analysis)
- OAuth tokens encrypted at rest via Supabase Vault
- Row-Level Security on every table — multi-tenancy by design
- GDPR-ready: data hosted in Ireland, audit logs, right-to-delete
